checks: zero bytes, all 256 byte values, 6 MiB, POST/PUT/PATCH match receiver SHA-256
request switches keep attachments separate and never reuse another request file
Send during replacement read waits and sends the new file, never the old one
file read completion updates its originating request even after switching selection
out-of-order completion cannot overwrite a newer file selection
read failure discards old bytes, blocks transmission, and recovers on reselection

asynchronous pre-request scripts use the attachment captured at Send
multipart insertion/deletion keep ready and pending file bytes on their original field

minimum sidebar width scrolls a single row and keyboard navigation reveals the selected category
reload explicitly requires file reselection, then sends the selected bytes correctly

revision restore confirmation stacks above the history drawer without closing it on cancellation
